group_position: first shot of grp003 — both girls on the blocking_map start (sitting_shelf), the same ground they held through grp002; no path in the map.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: on the same patch of grass at sitting_shelf, rolling from her front onto her back
characters.space_fragment_en: lying face down on the grass at the sister's sitting place, large in the near foreground on screen-right, rolling over onto her back
characters.facing: starts facing uphill into her sister, ends face up to the elm leaves

path.to: rolled onto her back on the same grass, head downhill, face to the canopy

beats.action: still up on her elbows at the page
her head drops back from the book

beats.sync: after the line, into the silence

beats.action: picks one daisy at arm's length
lets the daisy fall onto her pinafore

performance.objective: give up on her sister without admitting she has been refused
performance.goal: give up on her sister without admitting she has been refused
performance.emotional_arc: from hopeful pestering to a heat-heavy, slightly sulky surrender
performance.end_state: on her back, mouth closed, eyes half-lidded on the leaves overhead, one hand open on her pinafore

characters.label: Alice's Sister
characters.start_pos: upright at sitting_shelf under the northern elm
characters.space_fragment_en: sitting upright at the sister's sitting place under the northern elm, small in the upper third on screen-left, eyes down on the book
characters.facing: square to the backwater, head bowed; she does not turn to speak the line

beats.action: turns a page and speaks over it
settles back into the new page

performance.objective: put the interruption down without looking up from her page
performance.goal: put the interruption down without looking up
performance.emotional_arc: from absorbed to absorbed, with one beat of mild elder-sister authority in the middle
performance.end_state: eyes back on the print, mouth closed, head unmoved, the turned page settling under her hand
